operation.text: 5.1 Access Control
Supplier restriction applies to list, search, totals, detail and download (message no. 3).
5.2 Search Operation
5.2.1 Initial Display
'PO Number' blank, 'Prod. Month From' = Current month, 'Prod. Month To' blank, 'Status' = Blank.
List shows POs within the user data scope matching the initial criteria, sorted by Production Month then PO Number ascending, 10 rows per page.
5.2.2 Button Operation
User clicks 'Search'.

items: If Prod. Month From > Prod. Month To, display message no. 1. Stop.
Retrieve POs by PO Number (partial), production month range and Status within the user data scope.
If no data, show 'No Data Found' (message no. 2).

operation.text: User clicks 'Clear': reset all criteria and the list Search box, show all documents within the user data scope.
Key-in on list 'Search' filters immediately. Click a sortable header to sort; click again to reverse.
User clicks 'Kolom': show / hide the checked column groups.
5.3 Detail and Download

User clicks 'PO Number': open 'Detail PO for #<No>' modal with the route detail (10 rows per page, sortable by Route, searchable) and the totals footer: '% Sharing Percentage for <Code>', 'Total QTY', 'Total. Price'.
Route Percentage = route Qty Total / document Total Qty (TBD, OP-09). Price Total = Qty 20 x Price 20 + Qty 40 x Price 40.
Approval History lists every action on the document, latest first.
User clicks 'Download' icon: download CSV '<PO Number>.csv' with header data, every route and a TOTAL row (format TBD, OP-10).
5.4 PO Status

rows: Created when PR is approved by DH; deadline = PO date + Day + 1 (System Master)
Approved manually by General Affair before the deadline
Deadline passed; set by the scheduled job (Approved By = SYSTEM)
Rejected by General Affair with Reason; PR returned to PR Creation

items: G-MO-02 Approval levels: UISS / code: SH / DpH / DH per PR. DB: CRITERIA_SCORE_APPROVAL.APPROVAL_CLASS + APPROVAL_STS varchar(2). Recommendation: Level codes TBD
G-MO-03 Approval history: UISS / code: History grid with from / to status, role. DB: No history table. Recommendation: Show approval rows or add a history table
G-MO-04 Trucking code: UISS / code: Varchar 3. DB: COMPANY_ID varchar(10). Recommendation: Align with Master Trucking Company

G-PO-01 PO number source: UISS / code: PO number created in ELIPS (monthly-workflow.js createPO). DB: PO_DETAIL.PO_NUMBER varchar(16); PAS returns PO numbers (SA_DETAIL.PAS_PO_NUMBER). Recommendation: Confirm whether the monthly PO number is ELIPS or PAS generated
